articles.title: Uber Takes Stake In Delivery Hero From Prosus
articles.mainIdea: Uber Takes Stake In Delivery Hero From Prosus
articles.summary: GuruFocus.com: Uber Takes Stake In Delivery Hero From Prosus. Uber (NYSE:UBER) is making a subtle move in the delivery space, picking up a 4.5% stake in Delivery Hero as Prosus trims its position. Prosus sold around 13.6 million shares at 20 each, bringing in roughly 270 million and lowering its stake in Delivery Hero from 26.3% to 21.8%. For Uber, this is less about control and more about getting exposure to another major player in the global delivery market without making a full acquisition. Related tickers mentioned: DHER.DE, PRX.AS.

articles.title: Uber Deepens Delivery Hero Ties As Robotaxi Spend Reshapes Investor View
articles.mainIdea: Uber Deepens Delivery Hero Ties As Robotaxi Spend Reshapes Investor View
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Uber Deepens Delivery Hero Ties As Robotaxi Spend Reshapes Investor View. Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) has acquired an additional 4.5% stake in Delivery Hero, taking its holding to around 7%. The deal is a material cross-border investment in the food delivery sector between a leading US platform and a major European peer. This transaction comes alongside Uber's commitment of more than US$10 billion to robotaxi and autonomous vehicle expansion.
